rv.q: You gotta want to spend time with those songs, but this cast will make sure you have fun if you do.
Drury Lane Theatre’s production captures both the thrill of Holly’s sound and the poignancy of his too-short life, delivering an experience that feels as heartfelt as it is electrifying.
For younger audiences, and especially those theatergoers not quite so young, audiences who enjoy a good jukebox musical, BUDDY: THE BUDDY HOLLY STORY may be the perfect show.
This musical dazzles with electrifying performances that will ignite the theater and leave you craving more.
Drury Lane Theatre in Oakbrook is presenting a solid production of Alan Janes' "Buddy -The Buddy Holly Story".

It is not a penetrating biography, and it isn't particularly interested in psychological complexity. Its jukebox construction can feel mechanical, its storytelling is often skeletal and its radio-DJ narrator is largely superfluous.

cn.t: Critics enthusiastically embrace this energetic production, praising its rock 'n' roll vitality and celebration of Buddy Holly's musical legacy, with the show delivering crowd-pleasing performances that capture the spirit of the pioneering artist.
